item.title: NEET UG 2026 Application Deadline Extended to March 11
item.description: The National Testing Agency has extended the NEET UG 2026 online application deadline from March 8 to 11; check details about the latest NTA notification for the medical entrance exam

item.title: All-Women Crew Operates Jodhpur–Bhopal Exp on Women’s Day
item.description: On International Women’s Day, North Western Railway’s Jodhpur Division assigned an all-women crew to operate the Jodhpur-Bhopal Express from Jodhpur to Jaipur

item.title: Heatwave Alert: Temperature in State May Cross 41°C
item.description: Heatwave conditions hit Rajasthan as Pilani and Barmer record temperatures above 40°C in early March; IMD Jaipur warns southwest districts may see temperatures rise above 41°C

item.title: 'Begging' Elephant in UP Rescued After Years of Abuse
item.description: A 26-year-old elephant named Veer was rescued from years of begging and forced labour in Mau, Uttar Pradesh by Wildlife SOS and the forest department

item.title: CAIT Women Wing Starts Skill Training for Women Inmates
item.description: CAT Women Wing Udaipur launches a skill development initiative at the women’s correctional home; plans training in handicrafts and livelihood skills on International Women’s Day

item.title: धार्मिक और पर्यटन स्थलों के आस पास धूम्रपान तंबाकू की दुकानों पर पाबंदी लगाने की मांग
item.description: मांग को लेकर जिला कांग्रेस कमेटी उदयपुर (पर्यावरण संरक्षण प्रकोष्ठ) ने जिला कलेक्टर को ज्ञापन सौंपा है

item.title: Middle East Conflict LIVE: 'War Could End Very Soon', Says Trump
item.description: US President Donald Trump warns Iran of a massive retaliation if oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz are blocked; Iran refuses negotiations with the US as regional strikes continue

item.title: Udaipur Police Issues Special Number for Public to Report Crime
item.description: Udaipur SP Yogesh Goyal releases WhatsApp number 8764527201 for citizens to report crime, illegal drugs, liquor, weapons and other unlawful activities confidentially

item.title: Admissions to Mahatma Gandhi English Medium School from March 14
item.description: Applications for admissions into 3,737 Mahatma Gandhi English Medium Schools in Rajasthan will be open till March 23; lottery selection on March 25 if applications exceeds available seats

item.title: NCERT Issues Public Apology, Withdraws Class 8 Book
item.description: NCERT apologised and withdrew a Class 8 Social Science textbook after the Supreme Court raised concerns over references to 'judicial corruption' in a chapter on the judiciary
